visualReview.scope: Detailed operating exterior of Eshima Ohashi, including the complete crossing and curved Tottori approach.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all14 current portable frames. Published span structure, steep road profile, full-height oval main piers, open pedestrian rails, bay support ribs, wind screens, navigation markers and central comb joint are present. Bay drains now follow the widened curb. Turntable views establish the full1.446km silhouette; named close views resolve the small fittings.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all14 current shared-material/sky-PMREM frames. Shared fine-grain concrete and painted metal retain construction seams, casting ties and handrail sections. Transparent bay wind screens remain visible. Asphalt and markings retain local rough PBR response without per-model bitmaps. Geographic fixture model load/unload checks pass.

fidelityReview.notes: 814,362-triangle original exterior with measured55+150+250+150+55m main spans, repeated approach spans, tapered box sections, oval rigid-frame piers, casting seams and form ties, widened maintenance bays and ribs, transparent wind screens, individually modeled rail posts/infill, roadway curbs/markings, lamps, grated drains/downpipes, navigation signs and comb/sliding expansion details. Primary contractor plans, the port inspection plan, JSCE construction paper, JST2018 elevation diagram and contractor operating photographs were reviewed. Fine member sections, lamp spacing, bay lengths, foundation exposure and weathering are photographic reconstruction. Buried/underwater foundations, interiors, temporary construction equipment and roads beyond the crossing are outside this exterior asset.
